subtitle: Hot honey · Blue cheese ranch
notes: Ingredient amounts are reconstructed home-kitchen estimates from the video transcript, not verified Fallow quantities.

title: Satay Chicken — No Coconut Milk
subtitle: Peanut sauce · BBQ, air fryer or oven

groups.title: Satay sauce
items: ½ cup water, plus more to thin

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Cut chicken into even pieces. Mix the marinade and coat the chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.text: Combine sauce ingredients in a small pan. Warm gently, stirring, and thin with water to your preferred consistency.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook on the BBQ for about 10–12 minutes, in the air fryer at 200°C for about 10–12 minutes, or in the oven at 220°C for about 15–18 minutes. Turn as needed. Timing depends on piece size; check chicken reaches 75°C internally.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with the warm sauce. Rice and vegetables can be prepared separately.

notes: Your no-coconut-milk version. Sauce is separate from raw-chicken marinade.

title: Soy Milk Mac & Cheese
subtitle: Cornflake & chive topping

groups.title: Pasta & sauce
items: Optional: 1 cup cooked smoked chicken or salami
Optional: paprika or mustard, to taste

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.text: Cook macaroni until just shy of fully cooked. Drain. Heat oven to 180°C.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.text: Melt butter, stir in flour and cook briefly. Gradually whisk in soy milk until smooth and thickened. Reduce heat and melt in cheeses. Add optional ingredients if using.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Mix pasta and sauce in a baking dish. Combine cornflakes, butter or oil and chives; scatter over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes until hot and the topping is golden.

notes: Soy milk version with the cornflake and chive topping.

title: Chicken Mince Bolognese — 1 kg Batch
subtitle: Family batch · Soy milk optional

steps.title: Soften vegetables
steps.text: Heat oil and sauté onion, carrot and optional celery for 6–8 minutes. Add garlic for 30–60 seconds.

steps.title: Brown mince
steps.text: Brown the mince in two batches, breaking up lumps. Return all mince and vegetables to the pan.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Fry tomato paste for 1–2 minutes. Add tomatoes, stock, herbs, paprika and Worcestershire. Season to taste.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer uncovered for 35–45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add optional soy milk during the last 10 minutes. Add a little water if too thick; cook longer uncovered if too thin. Ensure chicken mince is cooked through.

steps.title: Serve or portion
steps.text: Serve with separately cooked pasta, or cool promptly and portion for the freezer.

notes: Recovered 1 kg batch using one 400 g tin of tomatoes. This is a mince sauce, not a meatball mixture.

title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
subtitle: Low and slow · BBQ finish

groups.title: Pork & cooking liquid
items: ½ cup apple juice or cider vinegar

groups.title: Finish
items: Up to 1 cup BBQ sauce, to taste

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Mix rub ingredients. Coat pork and place on the sliced onion in the slow cooker. Add the cooking liquid.

steps.title: Slow cook
steps.text: Cook on LOW for 8–10 hours until easily pulled apart. Use tenderness rather than time alone.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Lift pork out, remove string and large fat pieces, then shred. Reserve and skim the cooking liquid.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Mix pork with some reserved juices and BBQ sauce to taste. If you want to divide into different flavours, divide the plain shredded pork first.

steps.title: Optional crisp
steps.text: Spread pork on a tray and crisp at 220°C for 10–15 minutes, watching closely.

notes: The BBQ base was recovered. The exact separate taco-finishing mix was not retrieved, so it has not been invented.

title: Chicken, Brie & Mushroom Risotto
subtitle: Arborio · Mushrooms · Spinach

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear chicken in a little oil, then set aside. Brown mushrooms separately.

steps.title: Start rice
steps.text: Soften onion in butter and oil, add garlic, then toast rice for 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Add stock
steps.text: Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring and allowing each addition to absorb before adding more.

steps.title: Finish cooking
steps.text: Return chicken and mushrooms after about 8–10 minutes. Continue adding stock until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through to 75°C.

steps.title: Finish off heat
steps.text: Take off heat. Stir in brie, a little butter, optional cheddar and spinach. Loosen with stock if needed.

notes: Butter and oil amounts were not specified in the recovered recipe. Servings were not recorded.

title: Butter Chicken
subtitle: Yoghurt marinade · Creamy tomato sauce

groups.title: Marinade
items: 600–800 g chicken thigh, cut into pieces

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Coat chicken with all marinade ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.

steps.title: Brown chicken
steps.text: Roast at 220°C for 15–20 minutes, or brown in batches in a pan. It will finish cooking in the sauce.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Heat butter and oil. Sauté onion for 5–8 minutes, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then spices for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer tomatoes
steps.text: Add tomatoes and paste. Simmer for 10–15 minutes. Blend the sauce carefully until smooth if desired.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return chicken and simmer for about 10 minutes, ensuring 75°C internally. Stir in cream, sugar, finishing butter and optional kasuri methi. Season and garnish with coriander.

notes: Recovered thigh version. Rice and roti are separate.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
subtitle: Spiced chicken · Tomato masala sauce

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix chicken with marinade ingredients and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.

steps.title: Sear chicken
steps.text: Sear chicken in batches in a hot pan and set aside.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.text: Using the sauce oil and butter, soften onion, then add garlic and ginger. Stir in spices briefly. Add tomatoes and paste; simmer until reduced and the raw tomato flavour has cooked out.

steps.title: Finish cooking
steps.text: Return chicken and juices and simmer gently until cooked through to 75°C. Add cream, finishing butter and optional sugar/kasuri methi. Season and top with coriander.

notes: Ingredient quantities recovered from the original chat; the later method steps were reconstructed for the app from the retrieved searing step.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
subtitle: Melting cheese · Toasted wraps

groups.title: Quesadillas
items: 2 tbsp cream cheese, sour cream or mayonnaise
1 tbsp BBQ sauce, sweet chilli sauce or taco seasoning

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.text: Cook chicken through to 75°C internally, then shred or chop finely.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.text: Sauté onion, capsicum and garlic until softened. Mix chicken with your chosen creamy ingredient and sauce or seasoning.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Add filling, vegetables and cheese to one half of each wrap and fold over.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Pan-cook for about 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese is melted. Cut into wedges.

notes: Recovered base recipe. The separate variation recipes in the old PDF were not available.

title: Quick Chicken Sushi Rolls
subtitle: Teriyaki · Avocado · Cucumber

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.text: Rinse rice and cook with the measured water, following your rice cooker or saucepan method.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Dissolve sugar and salt in rice vinegar. Fold gently through cooked rice and let cool until comfortable to handle.

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.text: Pan-cook thighs for about 6–7 minutes per side, brushing with teriyaki sauce during the last 2 minutes. Check 75°C internally, then slice.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of rice on nori, leaving an edge clear. Add chicken, avocado and cucumber. Roll firmly with a sushi mat, seal the edge and slice with a damp sharp knife.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve promptly, or refrigerate promptly until serving.

notes: Nori, avocado and cucumber amounts were not specified in the recovered chat. Cooking and rolling wording reconstructed from the retrieved summary.

title: Porterhouse & Mushroom Stroganoff
subtitle: Mushrooms · Greek yoghurt sauce

groups.title: Stroganoff
items: ½ cup Greek yoghurt or YoPRO

steps.title: Sear beef
steps.text: Sear beef quickly in hot oil in batches. Set aside.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Soften onion, garlic and mushrooms for 5–8 minutes.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.text: Add Dijon, Worcestershire, stock and optional paprika. Simmer for 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish gently
steps.text: Reduce heat and allow the sauce to stop bubbling. Stir in yoghurt, then return beef and juices for 1–2 minutes to warm through. Avoid boiling after adding yoghurt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with your preferred rice, noodles or vegetables, prepared separately.

notes: The retrieved recipe did not preserve the Dijon and Worcestershire amounts; they are marked to taste rather than guessed.

title: Soy Milk Waffles
subtitle: Weighed ingredients · Crisp and golden

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Preheat the waffle maker.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Separately whisk eggs, soy milk, cooled melted butter and vanilla.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Stir wet ingredients into dry just until combined. Leave some small lumps. Rest 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in batches until deep golden and crisp, following your waffle maker’s timing. Keep finished waffles on a rack.

notes: Extra-crisp option from the chat: replace 30 g flour with 30 g cornflour.

title: Tomato & Capsicum Shakshuka
subtitle: Tomato · Capsicum · Eggs

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Soften onion and capsicum in oil. Add garlic, spices and tomato paste and stir briefly.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 20–30 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Add eggs
steps.text: For each serving, use a portion of the sauce and make wells for 2–3 eggs. Cover and cook gently for about 5–8 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your preference.

notes: Recovered tomato-base batch. Portion unused sauce separately before adding eggs.

title: Wholemeal Sourdough in the Cloche
subtitle: Wholemeal flour · Overnight ferment · Cloche

steps.title: Autolyse
steps.text: Mix flour and water until no dry patches remain. Cover and rest for 30–45 minutes.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.text: Work in the active starter and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Strengthen
steps.text: Do four sets of stretch and folds, about 30 minutes apart.

steps.title: Bulk ferment
steps.text: Keep covered until the dough has risen about 30–50% and feels aerated. The chat estimated another 1–3 hours after folds, but temperature and dough activity determine timing.

steps.title: Shape and refrigerate
steps.text: Shape a boule and place seam-side up in a well-floured banneton or lined bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 8–16 hours.

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Preheat the assembled cloche at 250°C for 45–60 minutes on a lower-middle shelf. Allow the full hour for the under-bench oven.

steps.title: Score and bake
steps.text: Turn out the cold dough onto baking paper, score briskly, and load the hot cloche. Bake covered at 250°C for 20–25 minutes, then uncovered at 220–230°C for 20–25 minutes. No added ice or water is needed in the cloche. Aim for 96–99°C internally.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 1–2 hours before slicing.

notes: Your recorded dough quantities, retained exactly. Fermentation time is a guide; watch the dough.

title: Smoked Pulled Pork for Tacos
subtitle: Pellet smoker · Taco night

groups.title: Pork
items: Mustard, enough for a thin binder
Apple juice or cider vinegar, for spritzing

groups.title: Serve
items: Optional: avocado crema or chipotle mayo

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Coat pork lightly with mustard, then rub. Heat the smoker to about 107°C (the original 225°F), using apple, hickory or pecan pellets.

steps.title: Smoke
steps.text: Smoke unwrapped to about 71°C internally, typically 4–5 hours. Spritz lightly every 60–90 minutes if needed.

steps.title: Wrap and finish
steps.text: Wrap and continue cooking until about 95°C internally and probe tender, typically another 2–3 hours. Temperature is a guide; the probe should slide in with little resistance.

steps.title: Rest and shred
steps.text: Rest wrapped for 30–60 minutes, then shred and mix through the juices.

steps.title: Build tacos
steps.text: Serve in corn tortillas with the toppings.

notes: Original Fahrenheit temperatures converted to Celsius for the app.

title: Smoked Chicken Breast
subtitle: Brined · Gently smoked

groups.title: Rub
items: ¾ tsp salt (reduce or omit if brined chicken is salty)

steps.title: Brine
steps.text: Dissolve salt and optional sugar in water, cool completely if warmed, add chicken and refrigerate for 2–4 hours.

steps.title: Dry and season
steps.text: Drain and pat dry. Apply the rub. Do not wash raw chicken under the tap.

steps.title: Smoke
steps.text: Smoke at 120°C for about 1½–2 hours. Check the thickest part with a thermometer; use 75°C as the app’s conservative chicken endpoint.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest for 5–10 minutes before slicing.

notes: Recovered 1.1 kg batch. Method wording updated to avoid rinsing raw poultry; temperature check retained.

title: Smoked Beef Chuck & Ribs
subtitle: One smoker session · Two beef cuts

groups.title: Shared rub
items: Optional: ½ tsp chilli or cayenne

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the smoker to 120°C. Mix rub and coat the chuck and ribs.

steps.title: Smoke
steps.text: Smoke together, checking each cut separately.

steps.title: Chuck
steps.text: Wrap the chuck when it reaches about 70–74°C. Continue to around 93–96°C and probe tender.

steps.title: Ribs
steps.text: Ribs were estimated at 4½–6 hours. Wrap if desired and cook until probe tender; do not rely on the clock alone.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest the cooked meat before slicing or pulling. Resting duration was not specified in the recovered chat.

notes: One smoker session with two cuts. Start checking tenderness before the estimated finishing time.

title: Freezer King Tomato & Vegetable Base
subtitle: Vegetable-rich sauce · Batch and freeze

groups.title: Base
items: Oregano, basil and thyme, to taste

steps.title: Soften vegetables
steps.text: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil until softened.

steps.title: Cook mushrooms
steps.text: Dry-sauté mushrooms separately until their moisture cooks off.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Add mushrooms, garlic and tomato paste to the vegetables. Stir briefly, then add tomatoes and herbs.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Simmer uncovered for 45–60 minutes until rich and thick. Remove bay leaves and season to taste.

steps.title: Portion
steps.text: Cool promptly, divide into portions and freeze. Use as a vegetable-rich base for later meals.

notes: Herb and bay-leaf quantities were not recorded in the recovered summary.

title: Chocolate Protein
subtitle: Soy milk · Lite ice cream

groups.title: Base
items: 500 g Vitasoy Protein Plus soy milk

groups.title: Optional after processing
items: Fruit, dark chocolate, crushed biscuit, nuts or a small spoonful of peanut butter

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend all base ingredients until smooth.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour into your machine-compatible tub without exceeding MAX FILL. Freeze level for 24 hours.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Use LITE ICE CREAM if available on your model. Follow your machine instructions for the equivalent program.

steps.title: Adjust texture
steps.text: If powdery after the first spin, make a small hole, add 15–30 g soy milk and RE-SPIN. Add any mix-ins after processing.

notes: Original sheet uses 700 mL tubs. Check your own tub size and MAX FILL; divide the base if needed.

title: Watermelon Lime
subtitle: FS301ANZ · Fruit slush

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Blend very smooth and strain. Chill the mixture.

steps.title: Check sugar and fill
steps.text: Follow your FS301ANZ manual for sugar requirements. The original sheet targets at least 5% total sugar, including fruit, juice and soy milk. Keep between the machine’s MIN and MAX fill marks (475 mL–1.89 L).

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Pour the cold, smooth mixture into the machine. Do not put ice or solid fruit directly into the vessel. Use SLUSH.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: If the mixture is too low in sugar to freeze, correct the sugar balance rather than repeatedly lowering the temperature.

notes: FS301ANZ recipe from your original sheet. Use the programme names available on your machine.
